info.title: Flowly.Tool
info.description: CLI tool for Flowly queue discovery and provider-specific infrastructure generation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Flowly queue discovery and infrastructure generation

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: queues
commands.description: Discover and print all Flowly queue names from one or more assemblies/projects

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to a compiled assembly containing Flowly configuration (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to a .csproj file or a folder containing a single .csproj (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration used when --project is provided

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework used when --project is provided (for multi-target projects)

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Do not build the project before resolving target assembly [default: False]

options.name: --configuration-type
options.description: Full type name or short type name of the FlowlyDesignTimeFactory-derived configuration class

options.name: --working-directory
options.description: Working directory used when running configuration (defaults to assembly directory)

options.name: --provider-name
options.description: Filter queues by provider name. Defaults to the primary provider.
